name: Owaaghedo Website
imageAlt: Homepage Hero section of the Owaaghedo Website
overview:
Owaaghedo is a Web3 writer and Key Opinion Leader (KOL) on X who shares educational content, industry updates, and insights with her audience.

The website brings her professional identity, services, articles, and community together in one place, giving visitors a clearer way to explore her work and connect with her beyond social media.
need: Relying on social media alone can make it harder to present your work, services, and content in one organised place. Owaaghedo needed a central platform that could support her professional identity and make her content easier to discover.
built: We created a personal brand website with a built-in blog for publishing Web3 articles and insights. Visitors can also share articles on X with their usernames included, helping encourage discussion and potentially extend the content's reach.
strategy: Bring her identity, content, and services together while making it easier for visitors to explore her work, engage with her ideas, and connect with her beyond social media.
